sections: 1. Hand hygiene as a performance indicator
assets.description: This table defines three types of bias relevant to observing hand hygiene compliance: observation bias, observer bias, and selection bias. | Selection bias | Observers systematically select certain times, care situations, health-care sectors, HCWs or opportunities fortheir observations; consequently, their results do not reflect the overall hand hygiene compliance |
